critical.finding: The table shows no fair value ('אין עדיין שווי אמין להצגה') and scenarios_he.md shows no prices. The cause is the unresolved forecast material issue possible_lender: liabilities are 51,409 of 58,149 total assets (88.4%) at 2026-09-30, with no cost-of-revenue line. The 10-Q balance sheet (pf_10q_20261029, reading/10q_2026-10-29.txt lines 262-318 and Note 8 lines 789-800) resolves the issue in favour of the operating classification, but not for the reason assumed. (1) Client funds are small: settlement obligations 2,151 plus restricted security deposits held for customers 2,231 make 4,382, which is 8.5% of liabilities. Matching assets: settlement assets 1,593, restricted deposits 2,231 and restricted cash 564. (2) Most of the liabilities are ordinary corporate items. Debt is 23,938 (short-term 1,749 plus long-term 22,189), 46.6% of liabilities: bonds that fund buybacks, not deposits. Accrued expenses are 13,950, of which customer incentives are 10,333. Other liabilities are 4,683 and accounts payable 1,083. (3) The ratio is high because buybacks shrank equity: treasury stock is 95,201 against retained earnings of 95,640, leaving total equity of 6,740. (4) There is no loan book: assets hold no loans or receivables from cardholders. Investments are 317. Settlement exposure is guaranteed but 'short-term and generally limited to a few days' (line 1069). Revenue is fees (net revenue 9,807 in Q3), interest expense is 653 for 9M, and the casefile card itself notes capex at 1.5% of revenue. MA is an operating fee platform, and FCFF with debt deducted is the right route; residual income is not.
